name: OECD
label: OECD
description: OECD official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: dataflow_list, data_get. Docs: https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2024/09/api.html · SDMX REST 2.0 https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/swagger/index.html?urls.primaryName=v2. Host https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/v2. stats.oecd.org went offline 2024-07-01. v1 paths under /public/rest remain available but this node uses v2. Citation required. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One OECD request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"dataflow_list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: dataflow_list | data_get. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'dataflow_list'.

schema.label: agencyID
schema.description: SDMX agency id for data_get. Example: OECD.SDD.NAD.

schema.label: key
schema.description: SDMX series key. Use * for all. Example: AUS.A.G.

schema.label: version
schema.description: Dataflow version or + for latest. Example: 1.0.

schema.label: time_period
schema.description: data_get time filter, sent as c[TIME_PERIOD]. Operators ge:/le:/eq: joined with +. Example: ge:2020-Q1+le:2024-Q4.

schema.label: firstNObservations
schema.description: data_get: first N observations per series. Example: 1.

schema.label: lastNObservations
schema.description: data_get: last N observations per series (most recent). Example: 1.

schema.label: detail
schema.description: data_get detail level. EXACT: full | dataonly | serieskeysonly | nodata. Default full.

schema.label: includeHistory
schema.description: data_get: include previous versions of the data. Default false.

schema.label: asOf
schema.description: data_get: data as it was at this point in time (ISO 8601). Example: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z.

schema.label: attributes
schema.description: attributes query. EXACT: all | none | dsds.

schema.label: updatedAfter
schema.description: ISO timestamp to return only updates after this time.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: dataflow_list, data_get.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 45. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
